title: Reverse Linked List
definition: The most famous linked list interview question. Involves using three pointers (`prev`, `curr`, `next`) to iteratively flip the direction of the `next` pointers in O(N) time and O(1) space.
simpleExplanation: Walking through the scavenger hunt and explicitly rewriting every clue to point backward instead of forward.

answers.question: **Basic:** Reverse Iteratively
**Advanced:** Reverse Recursively
